editorial.blurb: A spirited American tavern where excellent burgers, fresh seafood, and well-crafted drinks flow alongside lively conversation and reliable service.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit them up during lunch or brunch hours when there's rarely a wait, and don't sleep on the extensive menu—the brussel sprouts and club sandwich are huge crowd-pleasers.
signatureDishes: Black squid ink fettuccine with shrimp
